mutable_drift_policy: Docs pages are mutable; exact URL + version + access timestamp + excerpt retained in sources/. GitHub PR/release rows immutable by number/title. No silent rebind: S-IDs (research) and C-IDs (critic) carried forward unchanged; reviser performed no new web fetches and mints no rebinding IDs.
notes: Reviser-stage adjudication. Reviser read in full: brief.md, research/draft.md, research/discovery.md, research/revealed-plan.md, research/source-map.json + all S excerpts, critic/critique.md + critic/source-map.json + all C excerpts. Own-arm evidence carried forward below with original access_ts + observed_ops preserved and reviser_inspection noted per row. No new web_search/web_fetch; no code executed; no sandbox witnesses; no installs; no private provider internals. Usage/billing unobserved -> null throughout. Excerpt files copied verbatim into reviser sources/ for self-containment; see sources/index.md.
reviser_evidence_policy: Every criticism (M1-M11, m1-m10) was adjudicable on own-arm S+C evidence within scope/time, so no extra broad discovery was opened. Single-sourced (S-observed, C-not-re-observed) is distinguished from never-observed in final.md; neither class is silently asserted.
